'''Danu 4 (November 27)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|978}} - On their second day of recopying information, [[Moiraine]] and [[Siuan]] begin to secretly make their own copies of the records, limiting themselves to male infants born after [[Gitara]]'s [[Foretelling]] and near [[Dragonmount]]. Moiraine becomes aware of the [[White Tower]]'s intention to place her on the [[Sun Throne]] of [[Cairhien]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Mat]] arrives in [[Salidar]], to discover [[Egwene]] is [[Amyrlin]]. [[Elayne]] meets [[Aviendha]] again.
*{{ne|999}} - [[Min]] and the Salidar embassy arrive in [[Caemlyn]]. [[Rand]] visits the farm and warns [[Taim]] to keep the [[Asha'man]] away from Caemlyn. [[Merana Ambrey]], [[Seonid Traighan]] and [[Masuri Sokawa]] meet with Rand in the afternoon.
*{{ne|999}} - Mat dances with [[Halima]], who [[channel]]s at him.
